record.reviewer: Volunteer mentor: Name the dependency, not the person. Close on hope.
record.publishedText: I came to my first night with a heart that was looking for home in the wrong place. A dependency had taken the place of God in my life. Today I am walking in wholeness, and I want the same for you.
record.sentText: I came to the first night because of Nuala, and because the quiet at home had got too loud. We had lived together. I think what I had with her is what the leaflet calls dependency. I don't have a word for the part that wasn't. I do pray. That part is true.
